versions.changelog:
- Added explicit cost-awareness and context/output budgets to the governance workflow.
- Introduced lightweight default entry points and more granular task routing.
- Updated workflow and guardrails to include active status indexing, searchable archives, and refined proportional verification levels.
- Added two new files: CHANGELOG.md and Project-quality-improvement.txt.
- Removed obsolete files: agents, references, scripts, and skill-card.md.

Initial release of project-quality-governance skill.

- Provides structured workflows for creating, auditing, or refactoring authoritative technical specifications and quality logs in engineering repositories.
- Introduces a hierarchical governance model, durable indexing, and scoped documentation changes.
- Defines validation levels and integrates proportionate, read-only documentation checks.
- Establishes guardrails to preserve contributor history, prevent scope creep, and ensure structural consistency without inventing facts.
- Includes references and scripts for specification structure, issue logging, and verification workflows.
